# What should this sign or banner job cost?

> Free sign shop pricing calculator: enter size, quantity, material, print and install time and your shop rate to get the price that earns your margin, your break-even, and the price per square foot at any quantity. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
